claims.statement: Deterministic full-order enumeration as specified in proof.md solves every honestly generated bls12-381-miller-inversion input with success probability 1, total classical work at most 2^310 target-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (C=20000), no advice or heuristics, and the explicit preprocessing and memory bounds in proof.md. For BLS this holds for every 1<=n<r and is scored at n=2^20; secp has no auxiliary n. This is an analytic, deliberately noncompetitive baseline, not a measured practical attack.
